findings.source_passage: more wrinkles than an unsettled pond
findings.source_locator: paragraph describing Jethro, after Cayden grants permission

findings.suggested_fix: Restore the exact phrase 'more wrinkles than an unsettled pond' to preserve the source's idiosyncratic voice register.

findings.suggested_fix: Restore Miriam's explicit identification: 'a bit of compressed clay dropped from the tire of the pig-men's truck,' keeping her observational logic intact.

summary: The draft is largely faithful and preserves all major plot and voice beats; two medium-severity paraphrases (Jethro's wrinkle simile and the pig-men clay identification) and one low-severity cut of a character micro-gesture are the only meaningful losses, insufficient to trigger regeneration.
